courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 南化水庫大壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「開口流速與收縮」與「潮位滯後與上浮」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；南化水庫大壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Opening velocity and contraction" and "Tidal lag and uplift" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Nanhua Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束；南化水庫大壩則以越域引水與公共原水供應韌性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads; Nanhua Dam centres on interbasin diversion and resilient raw water supply, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「開口流速與收縮」與「本地入流與越域供水」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到南化水庫大壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Opening velocity and contraction” and “Local inflow and imported supply”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Nanhua Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Catchment storm runoff volume", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
related.transfer: 可遷移「開口流速與收縮」與「潮位滯後與上浮」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Opening velocity and contraction" and "Tidal lag and uplift" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Maeslant storm-surge barrier must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束；荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘則以浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads; Maeslant storm-surge barrier centres on joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「開口流速與收縮」與「浮運吃水與壓載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「止水縫漏流診斷」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Opening velocity and contraction” and “Floating draft and ballast”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Maeslant storm-surge barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Seal leakage diagnosis", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
history.text: 東斯海爾德防潮閘位於荷蘭澤蘭，以平常保持開口、風暴時形成屏障的方式，兼顧潮汐環境與防洪需求。北海大洪水促成荷蘭強化防洪的三角洲工程計畫。 東斯海爾德防潮閘工程開始建設，後續保留開放潮汐設計。 東斯海爾德防潮閘完成，形成長期海口防護設施。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Eastern Scheldt Barrier in Zeeland combines normally open tidal exchange with storm protection, making ecological exchange and structural loading inseparable engineering questions. The North Sea flood prompts the Netherlands to strengthen protection through the Delta Works. Construction begins on the Eastern Scheldt Barrier with an open tidal configuration. The Eastern Scheldt Barrier is completed as a long-term estuary protection structure. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.textEn: The North Sea flood prompts the Netherlands to strengthen protection through the Delta Works.

history.textEn: Construction begins on the Eastern Scheldt Barrier with an open tidal configuration.

history.title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
history.text: 東斯海爾德防潮閘完成，形成長期海口防護設施。
history.textEn: The Eastern Scheldt Barrier is completed as a long-term estuary protection structure.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「開口流速與收縮」到「腐蝕餘厚與疲勞」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Opening velocity and contraction" through "Corrosion allowance and fatigue" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
